summary: OpenRouter routes many popular models with ':free' variants that cost nothing: 50 requests per day at up to 20 requests per minute on accounts holding under $10 in credits, rising to 1,000 requests per day once you have bought at least $10 of credits. One API key reaches dozens of free model endpoints.
claim_steps: Create a free account at openrouter.ai and open the Keys page.
Browse models filtered to the :free variants at openrouter.ai/models.
Call the OpenAI-compatible endpoint with your key, staying within the free rate limits.

Free usage limits: If you’re using a free model variant (with an ID ending in :free), the following limits apply:
Credits purchased (all time)	Requests per minute	Requests per day
Less than 10	20	50
At least 10	20	1000
